_comment: Cherry Studio MCP configuration. Cherry Studio configures MCP via its Settings UI: Settings -> MCP Servers -> Add Server. The fields below mirror that UI — 'name' = memograph, 'type' = stdio, 'command' = python, 'arguments' = the args list (one per line in the UI), and the env vars are added under the Environment Variables section. This JSON is a reference template; copy values into the form. Replace the vault path before use.
